theater: 厄勒海峽與波羅的海沿岸

battle.name: 炮艦戰爭
battle.theater: 厄勒海峽與波羅的海沿岸
battle.brief: 一八〇七年英國砲轟哥本哈根、丹麥主力艦隊損失之後，丹麥挪威以逾二百艘小型砲艇對抗皇家海軍封鎖，戰火遍及厄勒海峽、大小貝爾特與挪威沿岸，歷時七年。輪發手槍此時已退出野戰序列，線上服役的是燧發步槍與燧發手槍，砲艇上則架二十四磅砲，接舷作戰靠海軍陸戰隊的燧發卡賓槍與短身手槍。

kit.name: 輪發槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與衛兵。

countries: 交戰的兩方是丹麥—挪威王國與大不列顛及愛爾蘭聯合王國；瑞典起初保持中立，後來在一八〇八至〇九年與一八一三至一四年的兩次丹瑞戰役中站在英方一邊；俄羅斯在芬蘭戰爭中與丹麥同陣營，拿破崙的法國則是丹麥的政治與物資後盾。丹麥—挪威一方是丹麥王國與挪威王國組成的共主邦聯，克里斯蒂安七世在位而王儲腓特烈六世實際主持國政，海軍最高權力集中於克里斯蒂安堡的海軍總部與總監制之下，海軍少將兼砲艇總隊指揮斯滕·安德森·比勒是這一戰術的靈魂；挪威沿岸另有一套由海軍與海岸民兵共同經營的要塞守備體系，克里斯蒂安堡港內還泊著專供砲艇預備水手駐紮的「海豚」號巡防艦。英方是倫敦海軍部與皇家海軍的全球體系，北歐分遣隊由旗艦率數支巡邏支隊組成，旗艦指揮官先後有威廉·卡思卡特、詹姆斯·甘比爾與喬治·伍德，亞瑟·威爾斯利在早期亦以海軍身份參與，另有大批英籍私掠船與徵用武裝商船加入封鎖與偵察的隊伍。英國在歐洲大陸與地中海的戰事同樣吃緊，海軍只能以分隊巡邏的方式維持北歐存在，這正是丹麥敢於用小艇周旋的客觀條件。
countriesEn: The two sides were Denmark–Norway and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. Sweden was at first neutral and later sided with Britain in the two Dano-Swedish wars of 1808–09 and 1813–14; Russia fought on the same side as Denmark in the Finnish War, and Napoleonic France was Denmark's political and material backer. The Danish–Norwegian side was a personal union of the Kingdom of Denmark and the Kingdom of Norway, ruled by Christian VII with the crown prince Frederick VI actually conducting the business of government; the highest naval authority was concentrated in the naval headquarters and the directorate system at Copenhagen, and the admiral and commander of the gunboat flotilla, Steen Andersen Bille, was the soul of the tactic. Along the Norwegian coast there was a separate system of shore defences run jointly by the navy and the coastal militia, and the frigate Triton, in ordinary, lay in Copenhagen harbour to quarter the reserve crews of the gunboats. On the British side stood the global system of the Admiralty in London and the Royal Navy; the northern detachment was built around a flag ship and several cruising squadrons, with William Cathcart, James Gambier and George Wood as flag officers in turn, and Arthur Wellesley also serving in a naval capacity in the early phase, while a large number of British privateers and hired armed vessels joined the blockade and the scouting. British commitments in Europe and the Mediterranean were heavy at the same time, so the navy could only maintain its presence in northern Europe by patrolling in small detachments, and that was precisely the opening the Danes needed to manoeuvre their small craft.
people: 關鍵人物分散在兩個國家的艦隊與宮廷之間。丹麥方面，克里斯蒂安七世是名義上的國君，王儲腓特烈六世才是主導對英談判與軍費籌措的人；海軍少將斯滕·安德森·比勒自一八〇七年起把守挪威的砲艇戰術推到核心位置，被視為丹麥以小博大策略的主要設計者；海軍少尉漢斯·喬治·加德在報告中把丹麥砲艇分為加諾．查魯彭、加諾．約倫、莫爾特．查魯彭與莫爾特．巴克塞四型，逐型列出火炮、人數與編制，是這套兵種最完整的一手技術記錄；海軍准將約阿希姆·卡斯滕斯基奧爾德、卡爾·威廉·耶森、克里斯蒂安·約根森、尤里·法爾森、埃恩斯特·佩曼等人分別主持各次遠征；海軍少尉尼古拉·圖克森在弗拉德斯特蘭指揮砲艇隊攻下英軍火砲快船，佩德·尼古拉·斯基布斯特德中尉在耶林附近奪取英軍砲艇，凱蒂爾·梅爾斯泰特在北面陣亡。英方，威廉·卡思卡特以旗艦指揮官身份在北歐巡航，詹姆斯·甘比爾接任，喬治·伍德負責封鎖線的收緊；托馬斯·麥克納馬拉·羅素海軍中將報導赫利戈蘭島的投降，威廉·卡思卡特的兄弟威廉·卡思卡特在安霍爾特島的登陸中指揮海軍陸戰隊；理查德·拜倫、喬治·帕克、詹姆斯·斯圖爾特與喬治·貝茨沃思等人輪流指揮支隊，喬治·斯圖亞特勳爵在一次奪船行動中率隊登船。
peopleEn: The decisive figures were scattered between the fleets and the courts of the two countries. On the Danish side Christian VII was the nominal sovereign, while the crown prince Frederick VI was the man who actually directed the negotiations with Britain and the raising of money for the war; Admiral Steen Andersen Bille pushed the Norwegian gunboat tactic into the centre of Danish strategy from 1807 and is credited as the principal designer of the policy of hitting a materially stronger enemy with small craft; the junior lieutenant Hans Georg Garde, in his report, sorted the Danish gunboats into four classes — the Kanonchaluppen, the Kanonjollen, the Morterschaluppen and the Morterbarkasserne — listing the guns, the crews and the establishments of each, and this remains the most complete first-hand technical record of the arm. Rear-Admiral Joachim Castenschiold, Carl Wilhelm Jessen, Christian Jørgensen, Jørgen Falsen and Ernst Peymann each led expeditions of their own; the naval lieutenant Nicolai Tuxen commanded the gunboat flotilla out of Fladstrand and took a British gun-brig, the first lieutenant Peter Nicolay Skibsted captured a British gunboat off Djursland, and Ketil Melstedt was killed in the northern fighting. On the British side William Cathcart cruised in the north as flag officer, James Gambier succeeded him, and George Wood tightened the blockade line; Admiral Thomas McNamara Russell reported the capitulation of Heligoland, and William Cathcart's brother led the marines in the landing on Anholt. Richard Byron, George Parker, James Stewart and George Bettesworth commanded detachments in turn, and Lord George Stuart led the boarding party in one of the captures.
kits: 輪發手槍在一八〇七年的北歐早已不是野戰裝備。十六世紀的輪發機構造價高昂、機構複雜，早在一六〇〇年前後就被火繩與燧發機構取代，到拿破崙戰爭時只餘軍械庫中的舊藏、宮廷陳列與私人收藏這一種身分；它既不配發給丹麥砲艇水手，也不曾登上英國的軍艦。真正上線的裝備分在兩個體系。丹麥—挪威方面，砲艇由瑞典籍船匠弗雷德里克·亨里克·阿夫·查普曼設計的艇型演變而來，一次大勝後大力生產，總數超過二百艘，分為大艇與小艇兩種基本型別：大艇乘員七十六人，艏艉各架一門十八磅或二十四磅砲；小艇乘員二十四人，只有一門二十四磅砲。漢斯·喬治·加德的分類更細：加諾．查魯彭型配兩門二十四磅砲與四門四磅臼砲，戰時編制六十九至七十九人；加諾．約倫型配一門二十四磅砲與兩門四磅臼砲，四十一人；莫爾特．查魯彭型配一門百磅臼砲與兩門四磅臼砲，四十人；莫爾特．巴克塞型只配一門臼砲，十九人，發射五到七發後便容易漏水。挪威方面另建十艘縱帆砲艇以應付外海的粗浪。英方裝備是主力艦與護衛艦加大量小型武裝商船的組合，配有十八磅與六磅卡隆砲、康格里夫火箭與臼炮艇；輕武器上，英軍用褐貝絲式燧發滑膛步槍，軍官與海軍陸戰隊用燧發手槍，卡賓槍與水手彎刀則是接舷與登岸的標準配備。
kitsEn: By 1807 the wheellock pistol was no longer a field weapon anywhere in northern Europe. The sixteenth-century wheellock mechanism was costly and complicated and had been displaced by the matchlock and then the flintlock well before 1600; in the Napoleonic wars it survived only as an old item in arsenals, as a court display piece and as a collector's object. It was issued neither to the crews of Danish gunboats nor carried on board any British ship. What actually went into service belonged to two separate systems. The Danish–Norwegian gunboats grew out of hull types designed by the Swedish shipwright Fredrik Henrik af Chapman and were built in large numbers after the great loss of 1807, more than two hundred in all, in two basic models: the larger shallop with a crew of seventy-six men carrying an eighteen- or twenty-four-pounder at the bow and another in the stern, and the smaller barge with a crew of twenty-four and a single twenty-four-pounder. Hans Georg Garde's classification is finer still: the Kanonchaluppen carried two twenty-four-pounders and four four-pounder howitzers on a wartime establishment of sixty-nine to seventy-nine men; the Kanonjollen one twenty-four-pounder and two four-pounder howitzers, forty-one men; the Morterschaluppen one hundred-pounder mortar and two four-pounder howitzers, forty men; and the Morterbarkasserne a single mortar with nineteen men, and these tended to leak badly after five to seven shells had been fired. Ten schooner-rigged Norwegian gunboats were added to work the rough water of the outer coast. On the British side the equipment was a mixture of ships of the line and frigates with a great many small armed merchantmen, mounting eighteen- and six-pounder carronades, Congreve rockets and mortar vessels; in the light weapons the redcoats carried Brown Bess smoothbore flintlock muskets, officers and marines flintlock pistols, while carbines and sailors' cutlasses were the standard equipment for boarding and landing.
tactics: 雙方的戰術都圍繞「淺水」與「封鎖」兩個條件展開。丹麥的砲艇設計幾乎全為近岸而設：吃水淺、轉向靈活、目標小，適合在埃列海峽、大貝爾特、小貝爾特與挪威峽灣的窄水道中活動，但吃一發就容易沉，禁不起惡浪，也不宜正面硬撼主力艦。實際打法是分縱隊伏擊與掠奪商船：一八一〇年前後英方護航隊在鹽霍爾姆外海遭遇丹麥二十一艘砲艇與七艘臼炮艇的襲擊，十二到十三艘商船被奪走；同年在厄勒海峽，二十艘英國砲艇與七艘武裝小艇在三個分隊掩護下攻擊七十四砲主力艦「非洲」號，因主力艦吃水太深而無法拖走，才沒有被俘。丹麥的砲艇常分成三艘一隊、十五艘一隊的縱隊展開，以縱射火力壓住敵艦尾部，迫其捱受後方射擊；接近多用夜航與突然出現，也曾假借荷蘭旗號混入貝爾特海峽，趁英艦修理時偷襲船塢。一八一〇年起，丹麥改以砲艇為商船護航隊，限制貨船必須在莫恩島內側航行，輔以沿岸的號誌與傳令，把糧食一批批送入克里斯蒂安堡。英方的對策是封鎖加反游擊：以分隊巡邏封住航道，掩護大船隊由厄勒海峽與大貝爾特海峽出入，奪取丹麥私掠船與商船作為戰利品，同時在多個丹麥島嶼登陸，取得柴薪、淡水與牲畜；英軍還以三十六艇以上的小艦深入挪威外海搜尋，甚至北上巴倫支海襲擊哈斯維克與哈默費斯特，切斷丹麥與俄羅斯的波莫爾貿易。
tacticsEn: The tactics of both sides turned on two conditions: shallow water and the blockade. The Danish gunboats were designed almost entirely for inshore work — shallow draught, nimble handling, a small target, well suited to the narrow channels of the Sound, the Great Belt, the Little Belt and the Norwegian fjords, but easily sunk by a single hit, useless in a heavy sea and unsuited to a direct contest with ships of the line. The practice was to ambush in divisions and to strip merchant shipping: in 1810 a British convoy off Saltholm was attacked by twenty-one Danish gunboats and seven mortar boats and lost twelve or thirteen merchantmen; in the same year in the Sound, twenty British gunboats and seven armed launches came upon the seventy-four-gun Africa in three divisions, and it was only because the larger ship drew too much water to be towed that she was not taken. The Danish gunboats habitually formed up in divisions of three and of fifteen, pouring a raking fire into the quarter of a British ship so as to drive the fight aft, approached mostly by night and by sudden appearance, and on one occasion in 1809 flew Dutch colours into the Belts to work on the dockyard at Bergen while the British ship lay in repair. From 1810 the Danes used gunboats as the escort of their merchant shipping, confined cargo vessels to the inner side of the island of Møn, and combined this with shore signalling and couriers to bring grain into Copenhagen in steady lots. The British answer was blockade plus anti-guerrilla work: patrolling detachments closed the channels, escorted the great convoys out through the Sound and the Great Belt, took Danish privateers and merchantmen as prizes without necessarily firing a shot, and landed on several Danish islands to draw firewood, fresh water and livestock. British vessels also pushed north in numbers of thirty-six and upwards to sweep the Norwegian coast, and raided Hasvik and Hammerfest in the Barents Sea to cut the Pomor trade between Denmark and Russia.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。丹麥—挪威在損失主力艦隊後建造的砲艇總數超過二百艘，大艇乘員七十六人、小艇二十四人；按加德的分型，最大一型戰時編制六十九至七十九人，最小一型十九人。傷亡總數兩造相差懸殊：丹麥—挪威一方合計三千五百零二人，內中陣亡五百零三人、受傷三百八十二人、被俘二千四百三十九人，另損失戰艦二艘、俘獲或擊沉敵船七十五艘、有一艘自沉；英國與瑞典一方合計五百五十人，陣亡九十一人、受傷三百八十六人、失蹤四十八人，俘獲十四艘、另有二艘受損。逐場的數字也有記錄：一八〇八年三月二十二日宰蘭角之戰，英方「拿騾」號陣亡一人、受傷十六人，「堅毅」號陣亡四人、受傷二十七人，丹麥末級戰艦「克里斯蒂安·腓特烈親王」號沉沒，丹方陣亡五十五人、受傷八十八人；同年六月四日四艘丹麥砲艇在四小時的戰鬥後奪取英軍「蜻蜓」號，該艦五十人編制中艦長與十四名水手陣亡，另有二十二人死傷；六月十九日丹麥護衛艦「洛根」號與六艘砲艇擊潰英軍「海鷗」號，該艦陣亡八人、受傷二十人，含艦長在內，二十日後沉沒；十月廿日在埃列海峽「非洲」號被二十五艘砲艇與七艘小艇圍攻，陣亡九人、受傷五十一人。一八〇九年五月十八日英軍攻取安霍爾特島，守軍一百七十人。一八一〇年九月二日丹麥砲艇奪取英軍「鼴鼠」號，該艦二死九傷。一八一一年四月二十三日「天鵝」號在松寧松德遭三艘丹麥砲艇射擊，火藥艙進水被迫投降，於烏德瓦拉外海沉沒，陣亡二人；五月十一日英軍「來福槍手」號在設得蘭外海追了十二小時奪回「阿爾班」號，該船武裝十二門、人員五十八名；八月卅一日英方「信使」號與「阿爾及里娜」號在朗厄峽灣遭遇二十砲、十八砲與十六砲三艘丹麥護衛艦，雙方各死一人。一八一二年七月六日林格峽之戰，英方擊毀挪威護衛艦「娜雅登」號；八月二日英軍奪取丹麥戰船兩艘與一艘約四百噸的美國商船，英方陣亡九人、受傷十六人（其中二人不治），丹方陣亡十人、受傷十三人。一八一三年九月三日布蘇姆外海，十艘英國砲艇與四艘小艇被七艘丹麥砲艇擊退。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. Denmark–Norway built more than two hundred gunboats after the loss of its battle fleet, with a crew of seventy-six men in the larger type and twenty-four in the smaller; on Hans Georg Garde's classification the biggest type carried a wartime establishment of sixty-nine to seventy-nine men and the smallest nineteen. The totals of loss on the two sides are wildly unequal: Denmark–Norway lost three thousand five hundred and two men in all, of whom five hundred and three were killed, three hundred and eighty-two wounded and two thousand four hundred and thirty-nine captured, and it also lost two warships, took or sank seventy-five enemy vessels and scuttled one; Britain and Sweden lost five hundred and fifty men in all, ninety-one killed, three hundred and eighty-six wounded and forty-eight missing, and captured fourteen ships with two more damaged. Single actions are also recorded: at the Battle of Zealand Point on 22 March 1808 Nassau lost one man killed and sixteen wounded, Stately four killed and twenty-seven wounded, while the Danish last ship of the line, Prinds Christian Frederik, was destroyed with fifty-five of her men killed and eighty-eight wounded; on 4 June four Danish gunboats took the British Tickler after a four-hour fight, the Tickler losing her captain and fourteen men killed with twenty-two others killed or wounded from a crew of fifty; on 19 June the Danish brig Lougen with six gunboats defeated the British Seagull, which lost eight killed and twenty wounded including her captain and sank shortly after the capture; on 20 October Africa was beset in the Sound by twenty-five gunboats and seven launches, losing nine killed and fifty-one wounded. On 18 May 1809 the British carried Anholt, whose garrison numbered a hundred and seventy men. On 2 September 1810 Danish gunboats took the British Minx, which lost two dead and nine wounded. On 23 April 1811 the Swan was engaged by three Danish gunboats in Sunningsesund, her powder magazine was wetted, she was forced to surrender and sank off Uddevalla, two of her men being killed; on 11 May the British Rifleman chased the Alban for twelve hours off the Shetlands and retook her, the prize carrying twelve guns and fifty-eight men. On 31 July the British Brev Drageren and Algerine met the Danish brigs Langeland, Lügum and Kiel, mounting twenty, eighteen and sixteen guns, in the Long Sound, each British vessel losing one man killed. At the Battle of Lyngør on 6 July 1812 the British destroyed the Norwegian frigate Najaden; on 2 August the British took two Danish vessels and an American prize of some four hundred tons, losing nine killed and sixteen wounded, two of whom died of their wounds, against ten killed and thirteen wounded on the Danish side. On 3 September 1813 ten British gunboats and four barges were repelled by seven Danish gunboats off Büsum.
cause: 起因是拿破崙的大陸封鎖體系與北歐中立國的武裝中立政策正面相撞。一八〇一年第一次哥本哈根之戰後，丹麥—挪威宣稱武裝中立，用海軍保護出入丹麥與挪威水域的商船；英國要把北海貿易從法國體系中切開，就要求丹麥交出艦隊加入封鎖，拿破崙亦要求丹麥封鎖英國。一八〇七年英國在威廉·卡思卡特率領下砲轟哥本哈根，艦隊在港口被奪或被毀，局勢再也無法挽回：丹麥失去了可以與皇家海軍抗衡的骨幹，於是轉向以小艇周旋的非常手段，這也是「砲艦戰爭」得名的原因。另一條導火線在丹麥與瑞典之間：一八〇七年丹麥軍隊進入特羅爾海特運河的工地，瑞典軍隊將其驅逐，兩國關係破裂，一八〇八至〇九年爆發丹瑞戰爭，英方站在瑞典一邊，使北歐的對英抗爭與丹瑞的私人恩怨合成一條戰線。同時，英國需要維持波羅的海與北德的航路，並把封鎖延伸到俄國北方，波莫爾貿易與巴倫支海航線因此成為英國打擊的目標；丹麥—挪威則清楚知道只要商船無法出海，七年之後自己的海軍與經濟都會耗盡。
causeEn: The cause was the collision between Napoleon's continental system and the armed neutrality of the northern powers. After the First Battle of Copenhagen in 1801 Denmark–Norway proclaimed armed neutrality and used its navy to protect the shipping that flowed into and out of Danish and Norwegian waters; Britain, wanting to cut the trade of the North Sea away from the French system, demanded the Danish fleet be handed over to join the blockade, and Napoleon in turn required Denmark to close its ports against Britain. In 1807 the British bombarded Copenhagen under William Cathcart, the fleet was taken or destroyed in the harbour, and the situation could not be recovered: Denmark had lost the backbone with which it might have stood up to the Royal Navy, and so turned to the unorthodox expedient of small craft, which is where the name of the Gunboat War comes from. A second fuse lay between Denmark and Sweden: in 1807 Danish troops entered the works on the Trollhätte canal and were driven out by Swedish troops, relations broke down, and the Dano-Swedish War of 1808–09 followed, with Britain on the Swedish side, so that the resistance to Britain in the north and a private quarrel between Denmark and Sweden were welded into a single front. At the same time Britain needed to keep the Baltic and the northern German shipping lanes open and to extend the blockade to the north of Russia, which made the Pomor trade and the Barents Sea route a target; and Denmark–Norway understood perfectly well that if merchant shipping could not get to sea, then after seven years its navy and its economy would be spent.
impact: 影響首先是北歐地緣格局的重排。一八一四年一月十四日《基爾條約》結束戰爭：赫利戈蘭割予英國，挪威王國（格陵蘭、冰島與法羅群島除外）割予瑞典王，瑞典波美拉尼亞歸丹麥，丹麥取回安霍爾特島並獲得薩克斯－勞恩堡作為補償。挪威人拒絕接受條約把挪威當作 bargaining chip，一八一四年七月二十六日瑞典—挪威戰爭爆發，挪威乘亂在五月十七日制憲、一八一五年被迫與瑞典結盟，這條尾聲直接通向一九〇五年的挪威完全獨立。對丹麥而言，七年封鎖把一個航運大國變成一個小艇民族：海軍主力被摧毀後重建的只剩下淺水砲艇隊與商船護航體系，丹麥的造船重心也從遠洋主力艦轉向峽灣小艇，這一取向在其後一百年裡一直存在，直到一八六〇年代木殼蒸汽護衛艦重新問世。對英國而言，這是一場成本低而收益高的勝利：封鎖逼出了《基爾條約》，皇家海軍沒有損失一條主力艦就取得了北歐貿易的通行權，赫利戈蘭也成為對付法國的走私與間諜基地。整場衝突同時是英國在北海的制海權的實地檢驗，說明分隊巡邏加封鎖確實能壓制一支有 Coastal militia 與大量小艇的近海力量。
impactEn: The first effect was a redrawing of the northern European order. On 14 January 1814 the Treaty of Kiel ended the war: Heligoland was ceded to Britain, the Kingdom of Norway — except Greenland, Iceland and the Faroe Islands — to the King of Sweden, and Swedish Pomerania to Denmark, while Denmark recovered the island of Anholt and received the Duchy of Saxe-Lauenburg in compensation. The Norwegians refused to accept being treated as a mere bargaining chip, and the Swedish–Norwegian War broke out on 26 July 1814; the Norwegian constitution of 17 May was drawn up amid that upheaval, and the union with Sweden in 1815, which ended only with complete independence in 1905, follows directly from it. For Denmark the seven-year blockade turned a great shipping country into a nation of small boats: with the battle fleet destroyed, what was rebuilt was a shallow-draft gunboat force and a convoy system, and Danish shipbuilding turned from the ocean-going ship of the line to the fjord boat, an orientation that persisted for a century until wooden steam frigates reappeared in the 1860s. For Britain this was a cheap and profitable victory: the blockade forced the Treaty of Kiel, the Royal Navy gave up not a single ship of the line to obtain the right of passage in northern European trade, and Heligoland became a base for smuggling and espionage against France. The whole conflict was also a practical test of British sea power in the North Sea, demonstrating that patrolling detachments backed by a blockade could indeed hold down a coastal force equipped with a shore militia and a great many small craft.
result: 雙方都沒有取得完全的勝利。英國在七年裡始終控制丹麥水域，能把大船隊護送出埃列海峽，並在多次交火中重創丹麥砲艇隊，但始終無法把丹麥的抵抗連根拔起：丹麥砲艇在數年間先後奪取英軍「蜻蜓」號、「海鷗」號、「老虎」號、「鼴鼠」號與「阿爾班」號等數十艘船艦與商船，一八〇八年十月甚至在埃列海峽重創英軍七十四砲主力艦「非洲」號，使英國護航體系屢屢受挫；一八一一年進攻安霍爾特島的丹麥部隊近千人，雖因傷亡過重而撤回，卻證明封鎖線上仍有可以反擊的拳頭。丹麥—挪威則輸在時間：切斷商船航路就等於切斷國庫的稅源，縱觀七年，戰果多為暫時性的奪船，而英方能持續恢復航運。決定性的轉折在一八一三年十二月，瑞典軍在第六次反法同盟戰爭中自荷爾斯泰因登陸，逼近丹麥本土，首都與離島直接受威脅，丹麥—挪威被迫求和。一八一四年一月十四日《基爾條約》簽訂，戰爭以割地收場：挪威割予瑞典，赫利戈蘭割予英國，瑞典波美拉尼亞轉讓丹麥。戰後挪威民眾拒不承認這項安排，瑞典—挪威戰爭隨即開打，把北歐的局勢又拖入新的十年。
resultEn: Neither side won outright. Britain held the Danish waters throughout the seven years, was able to escort the great convoys out through the Sound, and mauled the Danish gunboat flotilla in repeated actions, but never rooted out Danish resistance: over the years the gunboats took the Tickler, the Seagull, the Tigress, the Minx and the Alban and a score of other vessels and merchantmen, and in October 1808 they mauled the seventy-four-gun Africa in the Sound, so that the British escort system was checked again and again; the Danish attempt on Anholt in February 1811 put nearly a thousand men ashore, and though they withdrew after heavy loss, it proved that the blockade line still had a fist to strike with. Denmark–Norway lost on time: to cut the merchant shipping was to cut the revenue, and over seven years the results were mostly the temporary seizure of ships, while Britain could always restore the trade. The decisive turn came in December 1813, when Swedish troops landed in Holstein during the War of the Sixth Coalition and came close to the Danish homeland, putting the capital and the islands directly at risk, and Denmark–Norway was forced to seek peace. The Treaty of Kiel was signed on 14 January 1814 and the war ended in a cession of territory: Norway to Sweden, Heligoland to Britain, Swedish Pomerania to Denmark. After the war the Norwegian people refused to accept the arrangement, and the Swedish–Norwegian War opened at once, dragging the northern question into a further decade.
